C1336.title: CAPTCHAgeddon Campaign Uses Fake CAPTCHA Pages to Deliver Malware
C1336.summary: A sophisticated malware campaign dubbed CAPTCHAgeddon leverages fake CAPTCHA verification pages to trick users into executing malicious PowerShell commands. Considered a next-generation variant of traditional fake browser update scams, this browser-based attack technique deceives users into manually running malicious code, leading to information theft or remote control.
